UPSC is NOT consulted in the following cases:
• Reservations in appointments
• Claims for reimbursement of legal expenses
• Temporary appointments
• Matters related to tribunals
• Certain diplomatic appointments

items: Exceptions to UPSC consultation are frequently asked in UPSC Prelims as statement-based options.
Remember that reservation matters for appointments (SC/ST/OBC) are strictly outside UPSC consultation scope.
Temporary appointments and tribunal-related matters are key areas where candidates often get confused.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: UPSC is not consulted on making reservations in appointments or posts for any backward class of citizens.
Claims for the reimbursement of legal expenses incurred by a civil servant are excluded from UPSC consultation.
Temporary or officiating appointments made under specific conditions do not require consultation with UPSC.
Matters related to tribunals and certain diplomatic appointments fall outside the advisory purview of the UPSC.
